### What exactly was measured, including population and exclusions?
supported: The measurement covers standard\-priority support cases submitted by paying repair shops\. It excludes urgent cases, internal test tickets, and cases unresolved at the reporting cutoff\. Each observation starts when a customer submits a new support case and ends at the first time that case is marked resolved by an agent\. The team uses business time rather than elapsed clock time, counting eight working hours per business day and excluding nights and weekends\.
